subject.title: Create codex / claude plugins for each crawler

question: Should crawlkit own shared scaffolding for crawler assistant plugins, or should per-crawler Codex/Claude bundles live entirely in downstream apps or ClawHub packages?
rationale: The request spans shared Go APIs, downstream app command ownership, assistant skill/plugin packaging, and marketplace publishing; source inspection cannot choose that product boundary safely.

options.title: Keep Bundles Outside Crawlkit
options.body: Use crawlkit only for shared metadata or command descriptors if a concrete API gap appears, and publish per-crawler bundles from downstream or ClawHub packages.

options.title: Add Shared Scaffolding
options.body: Define a small provider-neutral crawlkit package for plugin metadata or command descriptors while keeping app-specific workflows downstream.

options.title: Close As Out Of Scope
options.body: If maintainers do not want crawlkit involved, close this and ask for specific downstream or ClawHub package proposals instead.

recommendation.title: Keep Bundles Outside Crawlkit
recommendation.body: Use crawlkit only for shared metadata or command descriptors if a concrete API gap appears, and publish per-crawler bundles from downstream or ClawHub packages.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history on the shared crawler infrastructure and documented crawlkit ownership boundary.
